title: Kept
author: Rashmi Mohapatra/ ରଶ୍ମି ମହାପାତ୍ର
text:
Kept thing.
No use left in it.
Still kept.

Not from hope.
Hope would require instruction.
This has none.

It occupies
the corner where intention once stood,
a remainder without arithmetic.

It does not ask.
It does not answer.
It persists, which is different.

I try to remember
what it was meant to do.
The memory fails,
but the keeping does not.

It is lighter than purpose,
heavier than nothing.
An object that has outlived its reason
and mistaken that for permission.

To discard it
would require a future
in which the absence matters.

So it stays.
Witness to a task
that never quite happened,
evidence without a trial.

Kept,
because release would imply meaning,
and meaning has already
been used up.

Still kept.
stanzas: the corner where intention once stood,
what it was meant to do.
An object that has outlived its reason
